entry: deform timeline family (readSkeletonData caller block B14 0x28e060-0x28e338 plus the B14b 0x28e820-0x28e880 island and E6 0x28e8ac-0x28e8ec)
scope: Reconstructed deform-timeline C only: real Json accessors, real readCurve, real findSkin/findSlotIndex, real spSkin_getAttachment, real setError and dispose pair, the weighted 2*(vertexCount/3) computed through the 0x55555556 stack magic, the line-388 malloc, the inline frame "vertices" child walk (NOT _readVertices), the offset zero fill, the non-weighted base addend, the scale copy and the one-float publish tail. Synthetic boundaries: spDeformTimeline_create/setFrame (argument recorders whose layout follows the disassembled bodies), spCurveTimeline_setStepped/setCurve recorders, fixture heap + allocator roster, libc providers, hand-built Json nodes. E4 (0x28e55c) is NOT modelled; the driver reports the handoff. Not an original-equivalence claim.

boundary.e6_caller_correction: E6 is reached only from 0x28e464 `beq 0x28e8ac` in the drawOrder offsets loop; the deform slot loop stores the findSlotIndex result at [sp+0x3c] without a -1 test (0x28e0e4/0x28e0f4), so this is not a deform error
